commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+5' 2 - 1 An amazing individual effort from Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball into the left side of the goal and makes it 2:1. Antonio Sivera was helpless.
90+2' Eduardo Coudet has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yusi (Alaves) replacing Carles Alena.
90+2' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) replaces Pablo Ibanez.
90+2' Pablo Garcia (Betis) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
90+1' The attendance is 14810.
90+1' Lucas Boye (Alaves) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Lucas Boye (Alaves) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
90' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Antonio Sivera, who smothers the ball.
88' Miguel Ortiz interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Antonio Blanco (Alaves).
83' Carlos Vicente comes off the pitch to be replaced by Ander Guevara (Alaves).

83' Chimy Avila (Betis) missed a big chance! He produces a stunning volley from inside the box, but his effort goes not far wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
79' Here's the latest number of offsides – 5:3.
76' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a change. Ivan Corralejo Mantero (Betis) replaces Cedric Bakambu.
76' A substitution has been made. Pablo Fornals is replaced by Nelson Deossa (Betis).
75' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
74' Betis have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
74' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Chimy Avila (Betis). Betis force their opponents to concede a corner.
73' A player from Alaves takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Betis.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Toni Martinez leaves the pitch and Jon Guridi (Alaves) comes on.
71' Carles Alena (Alaves) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the right side of the goal, but Pau Lopez is equal to it and makes an easy save.
70' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the left-hand post, but Pau Lopez was alert and the score remains the same.
69' Carles Alena (Alaves) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
69' Carles Alena (Alaves) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Alaves force a corner. They send men into the box.
68' The resulting set piece from Alaves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
68' Marc Roca (Betis) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for a foul.
66' Carles Alena (Alaves) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
66' Chimy Avila (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but Antonio Sivera comes off his line to gather the ball.
64' This shall not pass! Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
64' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
62' The linesman makes the right call and Betis will have a corner.
60' Substitution. Sergi Altimira makes his way off the pitch and Chimy Avila (Betis) comes on as his replacement.
60' The referee signals a substitution. Pablo Garcia (Betis) is brought on as a substitute for Antony.
60' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to substitute Natan and he is replaced by Diego Llorente (Betis).
59' Alaves fail to score from a corner as Pau Lopez (Betis) leaps to collect the ball.
59' Alaves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Alaves have a corner.
58' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Alaves are awarded a corner kick.
57' Toni Martinez (Alaves) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
56' The current number of shots on goal is 7:3.
52' Fine attempt! Valentin Gomez (Betis) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.

47' 2 - 0 Pablo Ibanez displays his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross deep into the box. Toni Martinez (Alaves) gets onto the scoresheet by superbly heading it in off the left post – 2:0.
46' Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
45+2' Chance! Antonio Blanco (Alaves) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but Pau Lopez is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
45+1' The corner is swung in but Alaves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
42' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) rises above the defence inside the box, but his header flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
42' Betis take a short corner kick.
42' A cross from Angel Ortiz (Betis) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Betis will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
38' Alaves are ruled offside.
37' Carles Alena (Alaves) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
36' Natan (Betis) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
35' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Betis.

34' The opposition back off Toni Martinez (Alaves), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort low towards the middle of the goal, but Pau Lopez denies him with the save.
33' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
31' The Betis players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Miguel Ortiz. NO PENALTY!
30' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Betis, he's going to review using VAR.
30' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.

30' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for Betis.
28' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Antonio Sivera is equal to it and makes an easy save.
26' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) makes a rough challenge and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for a foul.

25' Antony (Betis) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Antonio Sivera guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
25' Jonny Otto (Alaves) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post.
23' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
22' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
21' Antony (Betis) swings it in and Pablo Fornals gets on the end of it, but Antonio Sivera shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
18' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Antonio Sivera.
16' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.

15' Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the bottom left corner. However, but he couldn't beat Pau Lopez, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
15' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
15' The referee blows his whistle after Angel Ortiz (Betis) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.

14' Good chance! Cedric Bakambu (Betis) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
12' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Carlos Vicente (Alaves) heads on.

12' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Pau Lopez has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
11' The ball is out of play. Alaves will have a chance to score from a corner.
9' Sergi Altimira (Betis) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
7' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) unleashes a close-range volley towards the bottom right corner, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score remains unchanged.
6' The ball is cleared after Lucas Boye (Alaves) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball has crossed the sideline. Alaves are taking a throw-in.
3' 1 - 0 Goal! Lucas Boye shows great vision to find Carlos Vicente (Alaves) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the left side of the goal. 1:0.
2' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Alaves will have the kick-off.
Miguel Ortiz will officiate today.
